limitations: One trace reload per environment; not a performance benchmark.
CpuProfiler::StartProfiling itself costs about 100 ms in each Worker.
The trace contains no explicit wasm compilation/instantiation timing event; createWasm sample time cannot be equated with total compile time.
Blob-instrumented probe is independent and modifies Worker source, so its absolute timings and trace timings are not interchangeable.

The generic parent-thread early-message gate is confirmed in exact Chromium 151.0.7922.34 source. DidEvaluateScript itself is not named in this trace; attribution of this particular approximately 604 ms idle interval to its blocked parent callback is source-supported inference, consistent with all recorded ordering.

chromium_source_confirmation.retrieval: Read official Gitiles tag files via ?format=TEXT and base64-decode; web open rejected URL, direct official HTTPS source retrieval succeeded.
mechanism: PostMessageToWorkerGlobalScope runs in parent context. If !was_script_evaluated_, it stores the message in queued_early_tasks_.
Worker DidEvaluateTopLevelScript posts DedicatedWorkerMessagingProxy::DidEvaluateScript to parent execution context TaskType::kInternalLoading.
Only after the parent callback executes does DidEvaluateScript set was_script_evaluated_=true, swap queued_early_tasks_, and post each message to the Worker kPostedMessage runner.
A synchronous long task on the parent/main thread can therefore delay delivery of the initial message even while the Worker is fully initialized and idle.
